text_block_list.text:
"Just as all the scheduled training menus 
had come to an end—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like almost everyone has already 
wrapped up and left for the day..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Guess we have no choice but to give up 
on training together.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis Groove, are you looking for a 
practice partner?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that was the plan, but student council 
duties ran late. Since my partner isn't 
here either, today is—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Then please, allow me to be your opponent.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You'll be my opponent, Dura? Nothing would 
please me more, but... are you not tired?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
There is no cause for concern. I will 
respond with a run worthy of standing 
against Big Sis Groove.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Above all, I simply cannot let an 
opportunity to race against Big Sis Groove 
slip away.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...So that's how it is, Trainer. You don't 
mind if I run alongside Sis Groove, right?
choice_data_list:

against Air Groove.

against Air Groove, huh?

yourself any further is out of the 
question.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh, full of motivation, aren't you? But 
don't expect me to let my juniors outshine 
me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Come. Show me just how much stronger 
you've become...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll give it—everything I've got...!

Training alongside Air Groove, the senior 
she so respected, she broke a sweat until 
late into the night.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: No, I'm still...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your Trainer knows your condition best, 
Dura. Wrap it up for today. I don't want 
to push you past your limits either.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it, there are plenty of 
chances to run side-by-side. Let's run 
again when we're both in top condition.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...It is unfortunate, but... it cannot be 
helped.

Duramente gave up on pairing up for 
training and called it a day.
